name: Authentic Sans Pro
classification_notes: A plain, systematic grotesque distributed in four numeric weights and two widths, functioning as a neutral workhorse sans rather than a display face.
summary: A neutral grotesque in four numeric weights and two widths, built as a plain, systematic workhorse sans.
description: Authentic Sans Pro is the commercial counterpart to the studio's open-source Authentic Sans, extending it with extra characters and a two-axis variable font. It runs in four weights, labelled 60 to 150, each available in normal and condensed widths.
foundry_blurb: AUTHENTIC recommend Authentic Sans Pro for commercial work, web fonts and projects requiring additional special or accented characters beyond the open-source release.

name: Untitled
classification_notes: Archived alongside historicist type revivals in third-party type references, indicating a serif built in that tradition rather than a grotesque or slab.
summary: A serif typeface available on request since 2016, used in poster work for Prague's National Theatre.
description: Untitled has been available directly from AUTHENTIC on request since 2016. It has seen limited public documentation, with its clearest outing in poster design for Národní divadlo, Prague's National Theatre.
foundry_blurb: AUTHENTIC list Untitled among their licensable typefaces, available on request since 2016.
